title: boechera retrofracta
intro: Boechera retrofracta, commonly known as Wyoming rockcress, is a flowering plant species native to the western United States. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Boechera retrofracta include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Boechera retrofracta include isothiocyanates, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as pain relief and anti-inflammatory effects.
